overview.zh: P4 碰撞保护先要求有效反馈和目标，再用最近 200 ms 方向速度（≥8°/s）确认关节曾经在动；之后若 release 600 ms/0.4° 或 tighten 750 ms/0.5° 进展不足且 PID 仍推，就把目标锁在当前反馈角。目标反向回退至少 1°才释放并重新观察。
overview.en: P4 collision protection first requires valid feedback/target, then uses recent 200 ms directional velocity (≥8°/s) to confirm the joint was moving. It enters HOLD when release makes <0.4° progress over 600 ms or tighten makes <0.5° over 750 ms while PID still pushes. It releases only after at least 1° target retreat and restarts monitoring.

zh.plain: 输入包含每关节目标角、磁编码器反馈角、反馈有效标志、控制上下文、时间戳、目标运动方向和 PID 推力标志。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: 碰撞策略是反馈运动窗口检测，不使用舵机 load；运动 service 把每个 joint 的输入送给 guard。
zh.failure: 无效输入或范围外 joint index 不可用于速度/停滞判断。
zh.recovery: 查看输入字段来自哪份快照及 feedbackValid/freshness。
zh.unknown: Input field presence does not prove sensor measurements are physically accurate.
zh.difference: This is the guard data entry; subsequent state is maintained independently per joint.
zh.change: 本次基线未标记该输入结构为变更。

en.condition: State/branch conditions are defined in CollisionSafetyPolicy::update and shown on connected edges.
en.effect: 输入字段存在不证明传感器物理测量准确。
en.failure: 该节点是 guard 的数据入口，后续状态按每个 joint 分别维护。
en.recovery: 查看输入字段来自哪份快照及 feedbackValid/freshness。
en.unknown: Input field presence does not prove sensor measurements are physically accurate.
en.difference: This is the guard data entry; subsequent state is maintained independently per joint.

zh.plain: 上下文失效、反馈标记无效或目标/反馈角不是有限数时，策略重置该关节监测状态。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: resetJoint 清除 candidate/armed/hold 和记忆窗口；活动 HOLD 会记录释放原因。
zh.failure: 坏反馈不会进入 velocity window，也不会继续维持旧 HOLD 判定。
zh.recovery: 恢复有效且新鲜的编码器反馈及控制上下文，再观察是否重新建立 candidate。
zh.unknown: Resetting monitor state does not repair the feedback fault cause.
zh.difference: This clears untrusted input state; it is not itself a collision diagnosis.
zh.change: 基线未标记该失效处理为变更。

en.plain: The policy resets per-joint monitoring when context is inactive, feedback is invalid, or target/feedback is non-finite.
en.condition: State/branch conditions are defined in CollisionSafetyPolicy::update and shown on connected edges.
en.effect: 重置状态不等于反馈故障根因已修复。
en.failure: 这是输入可信度清理，不是检测到机械碰撞。
en.recovery: 恢复有效且新鲜的编码器反馈及控制上下文，再观察是否重新建立 candidate。
en.unknown: Resetting monitor state does not repair the feedback fault cause.
en.difference: This clears untrusted input state; it is not itself a collision diagnosis.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this invalid-input handling as changed.

zh.plain: 新的运动段从 candidate 开始记目标方向、当前反馈和运动模式；目标变化达到 1°、方向切换或模式改变会重开窗口。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: 误差绝对值不超过 4° 时清掉监测；否则以方向化反馈建立 velocity/progress history。
zh.failure: 目标或模式不断改变会反复重置观察窗，因此不会累积旧运动证据。
zh.recovery: 确认 target 与 driveMotionMode 稳定，再观察最近 200 ms 速度。
zh.unknown: candidate means monitoring has begun, not that motion is proven normal or a collision occurred.
zh.difference: This is the initial observation stage before the armed threshold is met.
zh.change: 基线未标记该状态为变更。

en.plain: A new motion segment enters candidate and records target direction, feedback, and mode; a target delta of at least 1°, direction change, or mode change restarts the window.
en.condition: State/branch conditions are defined in CollisionSafetyPolicy::update and shown on connected edges.
en.effect: candidate 只表示开始观察，不代表已经确认正常或发生碰撞。
en.failure: 这是初始观察阶段，尚未达到 armed 阈值。
en.recovery: 确认 target 与 driveMotionMode 稳定，再观察最近 200 ms 速度。
en.unknown: candidate means monitoring has begun, not that motion is proven normal or a collision occurred.
en.difference: This is the initial observation stage before the armed threshold is met.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this state as changed.

zh.plain: 最近 200 ms 内沿目标方向的平均反馈速度达到 8°/s 才进入 armed，证明本运动段曾经正常移动。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: 武装后改用当前模式进展窗：release 为 600 ms/0.4°，tighten 为 750 ms/0.5°。
zh.failure: 如果速度窗未就绪或速度不足，就继续候选观察，不触发 HOLD。
zh.recovery: 检查反馈时间戳、运动方向和实际速度；未 armed 不等于已判碰撞。
zh.unknown: Velocity is derived from encoder angle, not force sensing or servo current.
zh.difference: The design proves prior motion before checking a later stall, reducing false alarms at rest.
zh.change: 基线未标记武装规则为变更。

en.plain: The guard enters armed only after direction-aligned average feedback velocity reaches 8°/s over the latest 200 ms, proving prior movement in this segment.
en.condition: State/branch conditions are defined in CollisionSafetyPolicy::update and shown on connected edges.
en.effect: 速度判定基于编码器角度，不是力传感器或伺服电流。
en.failure: 先证明正常移动，再监测之后是否停滞，避免静止初态误报。
en.recovery: 检查反馈时间戳、运动方向和实际速度；未 armed 不等于已判碰撞。
en.unknown: Velocity is derived from encoder angle, not force sensing or servo current.
en.difference: The design proves prior motion before checking a later stall, reducing false alarms at rest.
en.change: The baseline does not mark the arming rule as changed.

zh.plain: armed 后若所选 progress window 内沿目标方向进展不足且 PID 仍推目标，策略锁存 holdAngle/holdTarget 并进入 HOLD。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: 策略结果 holdActive 让 motion service 将该关节目标固定在 holdAngleDeg，并记录 armed/hold bitmap。
zh.failure: 只有低进展且 PID 仍施力同时成立才进入；单纯速度慢或目标误差大不足以单独触发。
zh.recovery: 停止继续推向阻挡方向，按安全操作将目标向回退至少 1°。
zh.unknown: HOLD is a per-joint software hold, not proof that an obstacle or external force was identified.
zh.difference: The guard prevents PID from continuing to push a stalled joint toward the blocked direction.
zh.change: 基线未标记该保护状态为变更。

en.plain: After arming, insufficient target-direction progress during the selected window while PID still pushes latches holdAngle/holdTarget and enters HOLD.
en.condition: State/branch conditions are defined in CollisionSafetyPolicy::update and shown on connected edges.
en.effect: HOLD 是针对每个 joint 的软件保持策略，不证明已识别真实碰撞物或外力。
en.failure: 此门禁防止 PID 在反馈停滞时继续把目标往阻挡方向推。
en.recovery: 停止继续推向阻挡方向，按安全操作将目标向回退至少 1°。
en.unknown: HOLD is a per-joint software hold, not proof that an obstacle or external force was identified.
en.difference: The guard prevents PID from continuing to push a stalled joint toward the blocked direction.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this protection state as changed.

zh.plain: 碰撞结果 holdActive 时，控制服务用 holdAngleDeg 替换当前 joint target，停止继续追逐原目标。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: 共享 hold bitmap 记录该 joint 正在保持，便于状态/诊断界面呈现。
zh.failure: 如果上游继续重复原目标，HOLD 会持续，直到满足目标回退释放阈值或上下文重置。
zh.recovery: 让目标沿相反方向退出至少 1°，而不是继续朝阻挡方向加压。
zh.unknown: The held angle is the latest trusted feedback angle, not a mechanical lock or power-off guarantee.
zh.difference: Freezing is the collision-policy result; STOP/E-stop is a separate command path.
zh.change: 基线未标记该输出动作为变更。

en.plain: When collision result holdActive is set, the control service replaces the joint target with holdAngleDeg instead of pursuing the original target.
en.condition: State/branch conditions are defined in CollisionSafetyPolicy::update and shown on connected edges.
en.effect: 固定角是最近可信反馈角，不是机械位置锁或断电保证。
en.failure: 冻结目标是 collision policy 的动作结果；STOP/E-stop 是不同命令路径。
en.recovery: 让目标沿相反方向退出至少 1°，而不是继续朝阻挡方向加压。
en.unknown: The held angle is the latest trusted feedback angle, not a mechanical lock or power-off guarantee.
en.difference: Freezing is the collision-policy result; STOP/E-stop is a separate command path.

zh.plain: 目标相对 HOLD 锁存目标沿反方向回退至少 1° 时释放 HOLD，清理窗口并以当前反馈开启新监测段。
zh.condition: 源码路径条件：``。具体状态条件见相连分支。
zh.effect: result.holdReleased 与 monitorReset 指示恢复；之后需要重新满足最近 200 ms 速度阈值才再次 armed。
zh.failure: 未达到回退阈值时保持 holdAngle，不解除保护。
zh.recovery: 先退出阻挡方向并等待反馈更新，再按正常命令重新发起运动。
zh.unknown: The threshold is target retreat, not proof that the joint physically moved 1°.
zh.difference: Release restarts collision monitoring but does not clear overload, E-stop, or other safety faults.
zh.change: 基线未标记释放路径为变更。

en.plain: When the target retreats at least 1° opposite the hold direction from the latched hold target, release HOLD, clear the window, and start monitoring from current feedback.

en.failure: 释放只重启监测状态，不清除其它 overload、E-stop 或安全故障。
en.recovery: 先退出阻挡方向并等待反馈更新，再按正常命令重新发起运动。
en.unknown: The threshold is target retreat, not proof that the joint physically moved 1°.
en.difference: Release restarts collision monitoring but does not clear overload, E-stop, or other safety faults.
en.change: The baseline does not mark the release path as changed.

en.plain: When true, holdReleased and monitorReset restart candidate monitoring from current feedback; when false, do not reopen the window.
en.condition: Source predicate: `result.holdReleased && result.monitorReset`. This edge explains how it selects the collision-state transition.
en.effect: When true, holdReleased and monitorReset restart candidate monitoring from current feedback; when false, do not reopen the window.
en.failure: When true, holdReleased and monitorReset restart candidate monitoring from current feedback; when false, do not reopen the window.
en.recovery: Inspect target, feedback, and window inputs; recover by holding or retreating as described.
en.unknown: The algorithm is source-backed but does not prove sensor truth or the physical cause of a stall.
